scope: diagnostic only; no optimization or formal timing
baseline: Pinned original GTS kNN plus the existing complete-ID adapter; no pivot cache
self_match: included; self distance shortcut is not membership exclusion
distance: original FP32 input subtraction, double accumulation and Euclidean-distance field; no reassociation
processes: one fresh G0 control and one Gcount process on fixed32; no public time ratio
gpu: user-authorized physical GPU1; freeze UUID privately after idle/NUMA0/lock checks; no foreign process signals
invariants: same output fields and complete G0/Gcount bitwise outputs
qualification: CPU instrumentation reversibility and parser tests; D96/960 N4097 synthetic K1/8/32, full oracle, ties/self; memcheck/racecheck/synccheck count kernel on fixed synthetic fixture; final fixed32 all-result oracle
per_node_record: 40 bytes: lower,node_bound,leaf_bound FP32; tested(1 bounded,2 labelled),passed,visits,valid_mask,compute_mask,accepted_mask,leaf_task uint32
participation: GPU-recorded per-object participation masks; count lanes in the original distance loop; not hardware scheduler occupancy, eligible warps, or dynamic SASS counts
accepted: passes the existing leaf disk filter, not final top-k membership
whole_leaf_prunable: strict original leaf lower > current disk at leaf entry, only when original bound was evaluated; equality retained
no_contribution: no returned top-k ID in the leaf; retrospective only, not a safe pruning certificate
final_bound_screen: lower > final kth is retrospective and unavailable at leaf entry; never counted as online eliminable work
packing_simulator: same visited leaf order, whole leaves only, no distance or layout change; two-leaf, three-leaf and sequential capacity32 packing; structural warp counts only
gate: diagnose whole-leaf >20% existing-information opportunity, or no-contribution >=30% PLUS a safe predicate, or widespread <=8/32 distance lanes, or whole-leaf packing materially increases distance-lane fill; no new GPU mechanism in this delivery
stop: stop at first runtime/quality/hash/admission failure; preserve faults, no favorable replacements
novelty: Diagnostic inventory, not a novelty claim. Existing bound recheck is rejected if already enforced. Generic packing is not presumed novel; independent prior-art/mechanism gate precedes later implementation.
not_claimed: warp loop reduction from prior cache timing
